description:
# ⚡ Hefty Hacks

**Hefty Hacks** is a fully-online **Finance × Trading** hackathon presented by **TechZap**. Over one intense sprint, engineers, quants and designers turn market chaos into working product — trading systems, market predictors, fintech, risk engines, DeFi and everything in between.

Pick a niche. Go absurdly deep. Ship something the street hasn't seen yet.

> 🌟 **Exclusive Career Opportunity**: The **Top 10 teams** will get a chance to participate in direct hiring rounds with leading companies and fast-growing startups. 
> 
> *(Selection for interviews and hiring is solely at the discretion of the participating companies and subject to their individual eligibility criteria and recruitment policies.)*

> **Finance. Trading. Innovation.** — one laptop, a thesis worth defending, and 36 hours to prove it.

---

## 🚀 What is Hefty Hacks?

The markets never sleep, and neither do great builders. Hefty Hacks challenges you to build at the intersection of **finance and trading** — from high-frequency execution engines to market predictors, robo-advisors, fraud radars and on-chain quant tooling.

There's one rule that decides winners: **go narrow.** Anyone can build "a trading app." The teams that win pick a niche so specific it sounds obsessive — then own it.

- 🌐 **100% Online** — hack from anywhere in the world
- 👥 **Teams of 2–6** — no solo entries; finance is a team sport
- 🗓️ **Final Hack Day: 31 Oct – 1 Nov** — a 36-hour build sprint
- 🏆 **₹75,000 prize pool** + free Azure credits + elite mentorship

---

## 🎯 Tracks

Build on either track — or fuse them into something nobody has shipped yet.

### 01 · Finance
Reinvent how money moves, grows and stays safe — on-chain or off.
- Payments, lending & neo-banking
- Personal finance & wealth autopilot
- Fraud, AML & risk intelligence
- Insurance, credit scoring & RegTech
- **Decentralized finance (DeFi)** — on-chain lending, tokenization & protocols

### 02 · Trading
Turn market microstructure into a working edge.
- Algo, HFT & execution engines
- Futures, options & derivatives tooling
- Market prediction & alt-data signals
- Backtesting & portfolio optimization

### 03 · Fusion *(the boldest bets score highest)*
Combine both tracks into something genuinely unique.
- Sentiment-to-signal fintech apps
- On-chain quant & DeFi execution
- Embedded trading inside consumer finance
- Your own uncharted crossover

---

## 🤖 On Using AI

**Bring the idea. Let AI sharpen it.**

Generating your idea straight from an AI is **strongly discouraged** — judges can smell a generated pitch, and a borrowed thesis has no conviction behind it. Instead:

1. Pick a niche narrow enough to defend in one sentence.
2. Write your **own** thesis first — the bet nobody else is making.
3. Use AI to attack it: what breaks, what's been tried, what's missing.
4. Refine, prototype, and ship the version only your team could build.

**Your niche, AI's leverage.** Originality is the edge we score for.

---

## ⚖️ How We Judge

- **Originality of the niche** — how sharp and defensible is the bet?
- **Technical depth** — did you actually build the hard part?
- **Working demo** — does it run and hold up under questions?
- **Market insight** — do you understand the problem you're solving?

A sharp, unique idea executed well beats a broad idea half-built.

---

## 🛠️ Presented by TechZap

Hefty Hacks is built and run by **TechZap** — bringing builders together to disrupt finance.

**Build. Innovate. Disrupt.**
---

### Ready to trade sleep for signal? Register your team and code the markets. ⚡📈

judges.about: Neeharika Sompalli is a Staff Software Engineer at Hashgraph and an active maintainer of the LF Decentralized Trust Hiero Consensus Node. She has more than 10 years of software engineering experience, with expertise in blockchain, distributed systems, transaction processing, payments, protocol engineering, system reliability, and performance. She is also an ACM Certified Reviewer and has experience evaluating technical hackathon submissions.
judges.name: Neeharika Sompalli

judges.about: Sachin Gurjar built payments infrastructure at TransFi, where he led the Payout product for automated vendor and payroll disbursement and built the Collections interface, settling international payments across 50 currencies into stablecoins. He now works full-time as an AI Engineer at Turing and is the founder of quickcommercemap.com, a public map and data publication covering India's quick-commerce sector with around 88,000 monthly visitors, sold on as a commercial data feed. He holds a USD 10,000 Polkadot Fast-Grant, awarded as sole applicant, for a portable on-chain identity and reputation system, and has shipped production Solidity, Rust and Substrate work. He publishes peer-reviewed research on LLM agents and applied machine learning with two papers in IEEE Xplore, reviews for IEEE and Springer conferences, and serves as a judge for LexHack 2026.
judges.job_title: AI Researcher and Founder of quickcommercemap.com
